ruleDefinitions.name: Console CodePage Lookup Via CHCP
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects use of chcp to look up the system locale value as part of host discovery

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") AND (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-c\\ .*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-r\\ .*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-k\\ .*")) AND process_path = RGX("\\\\chcp\\\.com$") AND (process_command_line = RGX("chcp$") OR process_command_line = RGX("chcp\\ $") OR process_command_line = RGX("chcp\\ \\ $")))
